title: Number of Children Under Age 12 Who were Injured in Taxis and Private Hire Cars
what_it_is: Number of Children Under Age 12 Who were Injured in Taxis and Private Hire Cars

sections.label: Child restraints in taxis
sections.summary: Passengers under 1.35 metres must use approved child restraints or seat belts in booster cushions, but taxis are exempt; injury data for children in taxis and private hire cars is given.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For passengers under 1.35 metres in height, we require them to be properly secured using approved child restraints, which include child car seats, or using seat belts when seated in booster seat cushions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Between 2018 and 2022, 48 children under 12 years old were injured in taxis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As the use of child restraints and seat belts when seated in a booster cushion for passengers under 1.35 metres in height is not required for taxis, we do not have readily available data on whether children were seated in child restraints or wearing seat belts during an accident.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For private hire cars, between 2018 and 2022, 63 children under 12 years old were injured in private cars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: At the time of the accident, 35 were not wearing seat belts and 28 were not secured using child restraints or seatbelts while on a booster cushion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I ask whether the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) can start tracking, in terms of number of children who are injured in taxi accidents?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Could I ask MHA, from a safety standpoint, why is that this exemption for taxis under the Road Traffic (Motor Vehicles, Wearing of Seat Belts) Rules of 2011?

sections.label: Companies providing option
sections.summary: At least three companies have provided that option.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At least, three companies have provided that option.
